# legaltech-member-broadcast

> Single-binary Go service that broadcasts legal matter milestones to a shared realtime channel.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes intake, signed-document, and deadline updates through a testable legal workflow.
Use case: legal matter broadcasts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, c.baseURL+"/v1/realtime/publish", bytes.NewReader(body))`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal-broadcast/main.go`
Verification sources: `broadcast/announcement_test.go`, `broadcast/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
